 Orange Beach Fishing Charters 
 
 Fishing for over 60 years off the Alabama Gulf Coast, Gulf Rebel Charter Fishing is a family-owned and operated charter business in Orange Beach, Alabama. We offer family-friendly half-day, full-day, and overnight charter trips, and we will gladly build a trip to suit your needs. Schedule a charter on either of our fishing boats and have a blast with your group!Let's Go Fishing! 
 
 
 
 
 
 Red Snapper Fishing Trips 
 
 Catch your limit of Red Snapper on our private reefs, 7 days a week! Federal Red Snapper season for charter boats starts June 1st, 2025. We offer 6, 8, 10 and 12 hour snapper trips, and we can plan a custom trip to suit your needs. Red Snapper fishing trips are fun for all ages, so plan a trip for the whole family. Our boats can accommodate large groups, and are great for sports teams, corporate retreats, family reunions and more.We have been building and maintaining private reefs for over 50 years, so finding snapper is never a problem for us. These trips book up fast, so contact us today and let's schedule your trip! 
 
 
 Contact Us 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our Fishing Trips 
 
 Find the perfect trip for your group 
 At Gulf Rebel Charters we offer a wide range of charter fishing options to ensure you experience the perfect outing. Departure times can vary, and we can always build a trip to suit your needs. We offer fishing charters all year long, so call us anytime you want to catch some fish!

 🎣 2026 Season is HERE!

Triggerfish, Vermilion Snapper, Grouper, Reef Fish & Pelagics are WIDE OPEN right now!🔥

Red Snapper season is expected to open late May, with June 1st traditionally kicking things off through late September.

Bring your friends, bring the family or book a corporate trip! Small groups or large parties, we’ve got you covered.

📞 Call us for details & lock in your 2026 trip now!

 TESTIMONIALS 
 
 
 
 
 
 "Top notch outfit! I’ve been out on charters in the past and Gulf Rebel knows their stuff! They not only get you on the fish but are super polite. We had a group of us down here for USSSA girls softball nationals and some of the the dads decided to book a charter for red snapper season. Everything went super smooth and everyone was very accommodating… and everyone limited out too. I will 100% fish with them again!" 
 Jay Kristensen 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 "This is a first class operation. Captain Brian and his crew know how to treat their customers! We had an amazing trip and caught tons of fish and that is always a plus. The crew were very interactive and took care of us the entire trip. We plan to book with Gulf Rebel Charters every year and I would highly recommend booking them for your next fishing adventure!" 
 Benjamin Lau 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Absolutely the best fishing trip I have every been on. The deck hand was Amazing. He talked to us the entire trip, answered all of our questions. The captain would come out to make sure the fish we were catching were big enough and would move us if not. We caught our limit of Red snapper. Definitely would use these guys again for our next trip. Thank you so much. 
 Robert Thomas
